title: OMPAL: Bridging Speech and Learning with an Open-Source Mandarin Pronunciation Assessment Corpus for Global Learners
token_or_recording_size: 1,850 WAV utterances: 82 native + 1,768 French-L1 learner productions
annotation_target: word-level consonant/vowel/tone correctness; sentence-level accuracy/fluency/prosody; reference text
manual_scope: utterances independently judged by expert Mandarin teachers; repository exposes per-rater detailed JSON and aggregated scores
decision_reason: Primary openly licensed speech production with explicit human pronunciation judgments at word and sentence levels.
evidence_summary: Repository states 1,850 WAV files from 49 speakers and expert manual annotations; detailed JSON retains per-rater consonant, vowel, tone, accuracy, fluency and prosody judgments.
